arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('netnomos/finite.py')
text = path.read_text()
old = """        flat = np.arange(total, dtype=np.int64)
        self.values: list[np.ndarray] = []
        self.positions: list[np.ndarray] = []
        stride = 1
        for index in range(self.cell_count - 1, -1, -1):
            domain = np.asarray(self.cell_domains[index], dtype=np.int64)
            position = (flat // stride) % sizes[index]
            self.positions.append(position)
            self.values.append(domain[position])
            stride *= sizes[index]
"""
new = """        flat = np.arange(total, dtype=np.int64)
        self.values: list[np.ndarray] = [None] * self.cell_count
        self.positions: list[np.ndarray] = [None] * self.cell_count
        stride = 1
        for index in range(self.cell_count - 1, -1, -1):
            domain = np.asarray(self.cell_domains[index], dtype=np.int64)
            position = (flat // stride) % sizes[index]
            self.positions[index] = position
            self.values[index] = domain[position]
            stride *= sizes[index]
"""
assert old in text
path.write_text(text.replace(old, new))
print('patched')
PYEOF
